message: I’m sick of the trash mess at 55 Fenwood. The barrels are broken and they just keep piling bags on top so nothing closes. It’s gross and it's 85 degrees out, it’s going to start rotting.
There is a silver sedan double-parked on Newbury Street right in front of the cafe. It is blocking the delivery lane and making a mess of traffic.
There’s a pile of wet cardboard, an old rug, and a desk chair left at the end of my driveway on Centre St. I don't know who put it there but it's making the whole street look trashy.
The property at 201 South Street has garbage bags out on the sidewalk every single day of the week, not just on collection day. It's an eyesore and I'm tired of looking at it.
Three mattresses and a box spring on the sidewalk at 42 G St. in Southie. It's been out since the first of the month. Totally blocking the public way.
Can someone check out 99 Eutaw St? The bins are overflowing and they leave them right in the middle of the walking path. It’s impossible to walk by with a stroller without going into the street.
Hey, there is a car parked in front of the hydrant again at the corner of O and 7th. Really unsafe.

My landlord hasn't done anything about the black mold spreading across the bathroom ceiling on Commonwealth Ave for three weeks now and the smell is getting unbearable, please send someone to inspect.
It is 5 PM and there is a massive van double-parked on Washington Street near the station. It is creating a bottleneck for the buses.
I am a resident and there is a car without a sticker parked in my zone on Chestnut St. Please send an officer.
It is 5 PM and my recycling bin is still full and sitting in front of my building on E 4th St in Southie. Everyone else on the block got picked up this morning. Why was I skipped?

The curb along E Broadway in Southie is a disaster. It’s absolutely covered in trash and old flyers that look like they’ve been rotting since the Fourth of July. It’s really unsightly for the neighborhood.
My blue bin got absolutely crushed by the trash truck on Commonwealth Ave this morning. It's totally unusable now—can I get a replacement sent out to my address?
Hi, I live on Linden St in Allston. The street is filthy. There’s old litter and construction debris left over from a project weeks ago. It needs a good deep clean.

I have been dealing with a major roach infestation in my apartment on Commonwealth Ave for the last three weeks and my landlord keeps ignoring my emails about getting an exterminator out here, please help.

The massive oak tree right in front of 42 Beacon St has a huge branch hanging really low. It is scratching the tops of buses and is definitely going to take out a pedestrian soon. Can someone come by to trim it before it falls?
The street lamp right in front of 42 Beacon St has been blinking on and off for the past three nights and it is making it impossible to sleep. Can someone come fix this?

Someone just dumped three shredded car tires and a rusted-out sofa on the corner of Adams and Park Street near the bus stop. It is a total eyesore and people are already starting to toss regular trash bags on top of it. Please remove this mess before it gets any worse.

Hi, there is a dead cat on the sidewalk on E 4th Street in Southie. It looks like it might have been hit by a car. It is really upsetting to see and I would appreciate it if the city could send someone to pick it up soon.
Good morning. I am moving out of my apartment in Allston on the 31st and need to arrange for a mattress and a heavy dresser to be taken. Please let me know what the process is for a home pickup.
There is a car parked on the sidewalk on my street in JP. Kids have to walk in the road to get around it.

Hey, there is a massive crater in the middle of Commonwealth Ave right near the BU Bridge intersection that's been there for weeks now. It's getting dangerous for anyone on a bike or trying to dodge it in a car, can we please get some asphalt in there before someone blows a tire?
Somebody is parked in a resident-only spot on my street in Charlestown without a permit. They have been there all day.

Hi, the branches on the city tree at 12 Somerset St are growing right over the streetlight. The street is pitch black at night because the leaves are blocking the bulb. Please prune it back so we can see when we walk to the T station.

Can you please send someone to clean up the gutter at the corner of Centre and Perkins? The debris is blocking the storm drain and with these August thunderstorms, I’m worried it’s going to flood the sidewalk.

Hi, I am reaching out about Fallon Field in Roslindale. The grass is getting way too high to let the kids play, and there is a massive amount of trash left over from the weekend near the benches that has been sitting there since Sunday. Could someone please come out and take care of this? It's really turning into an eyesore for the neighborhood.

Hi, I live next to 42 Orchard St in JP and the backyard has become a total jungle. The weeds are over four feet high now and there is a bunch of old rotting furniture sitting right against the fence. It is really attracting rats at this point, can someone please make them clean it up?

There is a dead raccoon right in the middle of the bike lane on Commonwealth Ave near the BU bridge. It has been there since yesterday and it is starting to smell pretty bad in this heat. Can someone please come get it before a cyclist hits it?

Move-out season is killing us. Someone left a whole couch and three wooden chairs on the curb at 14 Oak St. Can you guys send a truck? It's been there for three days and is becoming a magnet for trash.
Hey, I need to get rid of a broken washing machine. It’s sitting in my driveway on E 4th Street in Southie. Let me know when you can swing by to haul it off.

Hi, I live over on Beacon Street near the park and there have been massive rats running across the sidewalk every evening this week. It is pretty disgusting and I am worried about them getting into the buildings nearby. Please send someone to check out the holes in the ground by the brick wall.

I live at 45 Beacon Street and the unit directly above me is clearly being used as an illegal Airbnb. There is a constant rotation of people coming in and out with suitcases at all hours of the night, it's loud and makes me feel really unsafe in my own building. Can someone please look into this?
Can you ticket the car blocking the curb cut on G Street? I have been trying to get my car out for twenty minutes.

Seriously? I hauled a heavy mattress out to the sidewalk for scheduled collection on Tuesday like the website said, and it is still sitting here rotting in the August heat. It's blocking half the sidewalk now. Please deal with this ASAP.
I have some furniture out back near the alleyway at 45 Elm Street that I need removed. Just a dresser and a couple of wooden chairs. When is the soonest you can come grab these?
My street looks like a dump. Bags of random junk and an old dresser are sitting out on the corner of Tremont and Hammond. Please send someone by to clear it, it smells.

The traffic signal at the intersection of Dorchester Ave and Adams St is completely dead and it is an absolute nightmare during rush hour. It has been out since this morning and people are just flying through the intersection without stopping. Someone is going to get hurt, can you please send someone to look at it?

The triple decker on the corner of Adams and Gibson has been leaving their trash out since Tuesday. It's not pickup day and the bags are ripped open by seagulls. Can you please have someone talk to the landlord?

The house at 18 Brookside Ave is a mess. The front lawn is completely overgrown with invasive weeds and there is a pile of construction debris left over from last year just sitting there. It is a real eyesore for the rest of the neighborhood.
Blocking the driveway on W Canton again. Getting really tired of not being able to leave my own house.

My landlord hasn't addressed the massive water stain on my ceiling in the South End for three weeks now and it's starting to smell like mold. I need someone to come out and look at this before the roof gives out entirely.
There is a car parked blocking the fire hydrant on my block in Dorchester. This has been here since last night.
Hey, just wanted to let you know there's a pile of bags and a broken IKEA desk right in front of the bus stop on Brighton Ave. It's hard for people to board. Thanks.
I have an old couch sitting on my porch on Commonwealth Ave that I need taken away. How do I get someone to come pick it up?
A sedan is parked in the no-parking zone right by the fire station on Tremont. Total obstruction.

The stop sign at the corner of W Canton and Appleton is completely twisted around and facing the wrong way. It’s been like this for three days and it’s dangerous with all the kids coming back to school soon.
There is a grey Honda parked completely inside the bike lane on Commonwealth Avenue. Dangerous for cyclists.
There is a massive pile of leaves and random trash stuck in the gutter on my block of Beacon St. It looks terrible. When is the next time a sweeper is coming through here?

Hi, I'm writing because the swing set at the Ronan Park playground on Adams Street has a chain that's completely snapped on the middle seat. It’s been hanging like that for over a week and the neighborhood kids are still trying to use it, which is super dangerous. Can someone come fix this before a kid gets hurt?

Hi, there is a section of the brick sidewalk right in front of 42 Beacon Street that is completely heaving up. I almost took a nasty spill walking my dog last night. Can someone come fix these loose bricks before a tourist breaks an ankle?

Hey, there is a dead tree stump at the corner of Centre and South St that has been sitting there for months. It is an eyesore and looks like it is rotting. Could you please send a crew to grind it down and remove it?

There is a guy operating a full-blown mechanic shop right out of his driveway on Quincy Street. Every single day for the past two weeks, there are cars being dismantled, oil leaking into the storm drain, and loud grinding noises starting at 7 AM. It's a residential neighborhood, not an industrial park, and it's getting out of hand.
There is a gross, stained mattress sitting on the sidewalk at the corner of Commonwealth and Pleasant since Tuesday. It's blocking the path for strollers. Please take it.
There is a massive pile of loose trash bags just sitting on the sidewalk at 18 Brookside Ave. It’s been sitting there for four days and it’s attracting rats. Please deal with this before the weekend.
There is a rusted refrigerator in the alley behind my building on Beacon Street that needs to go. It has been there for a week. Can someone come get it?

Hey, the house at 42 Myrtle St keeps putting their barrels out on the sidewalk three days early. They never have lids on them so the trash is constantly blowing all over the street. It smells awful in this heat.

Hey, just wanted to report that my yard waste bags are still sitting on the curb on Beacon St. They were supposed to be picked up yesterday morning, but the truck drove right past them. Can someone please come by and grab these before the rain hits?
I'm tired of looking at this garbage. Whoever moved out of the apartment building at 200 Harvard Ave left a mountain of bags and a bed frame on the sidewalk. Get this cleared please.

Could someone look into the vacant lot on the corner of Tremont and Hammond? It is absolutely filled with plastic bags and takeout containers. It looks terrible and is blowing trash all over the sidewalk every time the wind picks up. It has been like this for weeks.

Hi, I live over on Pond Street near the Arboretum and the mosquitoes have been absolutely relentless this August. It is getting dangerous to even step outside after 6pm. Could you please send someone to spray or check for standing water in the area? I am really worried about West Nile.

There is a huge infestation behind the dumpster area at the corner of Centre and South Street. I have seen at least five of them scurrying around my patio tonight and there is waste everywhere. Can someone come by to treat this area before they move inside?
Someone left their car in the bike lane on Mass Ave near Symphony Hall. It's been there since this morning.

Hey, there is a ton of broken glass and takeout containers piling up in the gutter right in front of 422 Commonwealth Ave. It’s been sitting there for weeks and I'm worried my dog is going to cut his paw on it during our walk. Can someone get a street sweeper out here?
Hi, I recently moved into an apartment on Commonwealth Ave and realized there are no recycling stickers on my bins. Could you please mail a set to me or drop some off so I don't get fined? Thanks.

The concrete sidewalk at the corner of Centre and South Street in JP is falling apart. Huge chunks are missing and it is super uneven. It has been like this since early July and it is a major hazard for people using wheelchairs or strollers.

There is a beat-up silver scooter dumped right in front of my building on Beacon St near the library. It has no plates, the tires are flat, and it has been sitting there for over three weeks now. Can someone come haul it away before it gets stripped for parts?

Hi, I moved into a smaller place on Marlborough Street and no longer have room for the city-issued recycling bin. Could someone come pick it up, or should I leave it out on the curb for you guys to take back?
Could someone come sweep the side of the road on Washington St near the library? It’s just full of plastic bottles and junk. It’s honestly gross walking past it every day.
The tenants at 122 Warren are just dumping their bags directly on the sidewalk instead of using bins. It’s a mess and it’s been like this all week. Please send an inspector.
Someone parked their SUV right in front of my driveway on E 4th St in Southie. I need to get to work, please help.
Hey there. I'm trying to get rid of a broken refrigerator. It's too heavy for me to move alone. Can you guys swing by 124 Dorchester Ave to pick it up? I've already cleared it out and unplugged it.
Can you please clear the sidewalk near the park on W Broadway? People have dumped their old dorm furniture everywhere and it’s impossible to walk past without going into the street.
Could you send someone to check the corner of Beacon and Charles? A car is parked right over the crosswalk and it is impossible for pedestrians to cross safely.
Urgent: a bunch of broken furniture including a smashed coffee table is on the sidewalk near the corner of Dorchester and Andrew. Really dangerous for pedestrians at night.

The sidewalk in front of my brownstone on Marlborough Street is looking really bare and sad. There used to be a beautiful elm tree here until it was taken down last year. Could we get a new sapling planted before the fall planting season? It gets so hot on this stretch of the block in August.
Is anyone coming to pick up the piles of furniture left by the students moving out? There is a recliner and a nightstand at 88 Beacon St. that have been sitting in the rain all week.

Hi, there is a giant pile of old drywall, wood scraps, and some broken bathroom tiles dumped right in the alley behind my building on Beacon Street. It has been sitting there since Monday morning and it is blocking the path to the bins. Can someone please come clear this out?

The trash bin at the corner of Commonwealth and Dartmouth has been overflowing since Friday morning and it is starting to smell pretty bad with this late August heat. Can someone please swing by to clear it out?
Just wanted to report a vehicle blocking the pedestrian ramp at the corner of Hanover and Cross. It is completely obstructing the walkway.

Hi, I have an old sofa that's been sitting in my living room for weeks since I moved. I need to get rid of it and wanted to schedule a pickup at my address on Beacon St. Please let me know the next available date.
